parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: Recommend
parameters.description: Whether to set the recommended service publishing to the service directory.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier launch-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id service-0e6fca6a51a544xxxxxx --service-version 1.0 --categories DevOps --client-token 10CM943JP0EN9D51H --recommend false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier LaunchService --region cn-hangzhou --Recommend false --Categories.1 DevOps --ServiceVersion '1.0' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken 10CM943JP0EN9D51H --ServiceId 'service-0e6fca6a51a544xxxxxx'
